title: Use one evaluation policy and task-pin predicate at admission and consumption
outcome: Use one evaluation policy and task-pin predicate at admission and consumption
acceptance: A test shows a switch from asserted to observed mechanical basis retires an asserted pass, preserving the distinct admission-only refusal when evaluation is disabled; no existing mode/mark behavior is widened

Admission and freshness call one owner for allowed mode and task-pin agreement; a test records a passing evaluation, strengthens the effective policy or changes the pin, and proves done becomes stale policy while admission of the now-disallowed mode refuses

completion.summary: Admission and consumption now share one private mode-policy/task-pin predicate, preserving existing refusals, phase differences and mechanical-basis retirement. Added exhaustive 96-cell assessment/admission/freshness matrix and disallowed-mode admission transition regression; updated lifecycle owner documentation.
